note: Rewritten from the original description of Araujo 1961 (English text with a Portuguese abstract). The soldier measurements are taken from TABLE 1 of the original and the alate measurements from TABLE 2; both tables are OCR output and some values cannot be read (for example head height, narrowest postmentum and pronotum length of the major soldier), so only the confirmed items are recorded, without rounding; of the "Range / Mean" headings only Range is used. The tibial spur formula "3-2-2" in the genus diagnosis follows the original, i.e. hind leg 3, middle leg 2, fore leg 2.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Major soldier: head brownish yellow, the tip of the frontal projection and the mandibles brown; thorax and abdomen pale. The head bears sparse setae, denser on the frontal projection; the head is elongate, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior corners rounded, the anterior corners slightly swollen and each with 1 small but distinct forward-directed spine. The mandibles are asymmetrical and stout, about 61% of the head length; the left mandible is strongly curved with an acute tip, its outer face broadly concave near the base, its inner face swollen at the distal quarter and grooved; the right mandible is straight, the tip bent downwards and acute, with a long groove below. The tip of the labrum is heart-shaped, its anterior margin concave. The postmentum is elongate and narrow, the sides nearly parallel and abruptly widened at both ends. The antennae have 14 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. The frontal projection is stout, projecting forwards and reaching half the length of the mandibles, its distal half turned upwards and its tip acute; the opening of the frontal gland lies on a small projection below it. The anterior lobe of the pronotum is darker than the posterior lobe, turned upwards, with a notch on the anterior margin.
Minor soldier: head brownish yellow, the tip of the frontal projection darker, the mandibles brown; thorax and abdomen pale. The head is densely covered with setae, fewer ventrally; the sides are nearly parallel and very slightly curved, the posterior corners rounded, the anterior corners straight and each with 1 small but distinct forward-directed spine. The mandibles are asymmetrical and slender, about 10% longer than the head, both slightly bent downwards; the left mandible is curved, slightly longer than the right, blade-like, with a grooved expansion near the tip and ending in a small point. The sides of the labrum are separate, its anterior margin double-curved, with very short but sharp lateral points. The postmentum is strongly constricted near the base, its sides strongly divergent, and in profile it is more prominent than in the major soldier. The antennae have 14 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. The frontal projection is stout, projecting forwards and upwards and reaching one third of the base of the mandibles; the anterior lobe of the pronotum is erect, with a toothed notch at the tip and with several long backward-directed setae on the anterior margin.
Features shared by the major and minor soldiers: a spine on the anterior margin of the genal angles of the head (above the mandibular condyles); the labrum of similar form and differing from that of other genera; similar pilosity, pronotum, colour, maxillary palps and labial palps; 1 stout spine on the outer side of the middle tibia; similar absolute antennal size and segment proportions. The two differ in that the major soldier has stouter and more asymmetrical mandibles, a longer head and a long, narrow postmentum. Measurements (major soldier / minor soldier): head length (to the tip of the frontal projection) 2.25—3.38 / 1.70—1.78 mm; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.95—2.70 / 1.42 mm; head length (to the tip of the spine) 1.99—2.78 / 1.60 mm; head height 0.80—0.99 / 0.70—0.80 mm; length of the left mandible 1.85 / 1.50—1.65 mm; length of the right mandible 1.43—1.80 / 1.50—1.61 mm; head width 1.13—1.28 / 0.98—1.05 mm; postmentum length 1.20—1.88 / 0.60—0.90 mm; maximum width of the postmentum 0.45—0.53 / 0.38—0.45 mm; minimum width of the postmentum 0.15—0.28 / 0.15—0.23 mm; pronotum length 0.80—0.87 / 0.80—0.85 mm; pronotum width 0.60—0.75 / 0.53—0.60 mm; mesonotum width 0.60—0.83 / 0.53—0.68 mm; metanotum width 0.68—0.83 / 0.60—0.75 mm; hind tibia length 0.98—1.08 / 0.90—0.98 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; the clypeus, labrum, mouthparts, antennae and the larger muscle-impression areas in front of the ocelli distinctly paler. The pronotum is paler than the head, the abdominal sternites and the legs still paler. The wings are hyaline, only the costa darker. The hairs of the head and pronotum are rather dense. The head is slightly concave around the fontanelle; the fontanelle is elongate and pear-shaped, slightly longer than the width of an ocellus. The compound eyes are bare, their distance to the lower margin of the head slightly less than their distance to the ocelli. The ocelli are nearly vertical, their diameter slightly smaller than an antennal socket. The postclypeus is more than 2 times as wide as long (8:3). The mandibles are as shown in fig. 1. The antennae have 15 segments, segment 1 equal to segments 2+3, segment 3 the smallest, about half of segment 2. The anterior margin of the pronotum is straight and raised, the lateral corners rounded, the sides rounded and converging towards the straight posterior margin, with a concavity on each side of the anterior margin and two pale spots on the midline. Measurements: head length (to the tip of the labrum) 2.30—2.63 mm, head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.88—0.90 mm, head width 1.05—1.20 mm, diameter of the compound eye 0.30 mm, distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.08 mm, ocellus length 0.11 mm and width 0.07 mm, distance from the ocellus to the compound eye 0.07 mm, distance from the ocellus to the fontanelle 0.32—0.36 mm, fontanelle length 0.08 mm and width 0.04 mm, pronotum length 0.53 mm and width 0.83—0.98 mm, hind tibia length 1.18—1.28 mm, forewing length (from the wing suture) 7.07—7.64 mm and width 1.70—1.84 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Genus characters: the soldier is dimorphic (major and minor soldier); the mandibles are asymmetrical and of the snapping type; the labrum is symmetrical; there is a conical frontal projection; each anterolateral corner of the head (above the mandibular condyles) bears 1 forward-directed spine; the tibial spur formula is 3-2-2, the tibiae bear a few scattered spines and the outer side of the middle tibia bears 1 stout spine; in the alate and worker the apical tooth of the mandibles is distinctly larger than the first marginal tooth, the right mandible shows no trace of a second marginal tooth and the left mandible has a distinct but small third marginal tooth separated from the fused first and second marginal teeth by a small concavity. The genus is closest to Cornicapritermes, from which it differs in that the latter has only one soldier type, its alate-worker left mandible has a relatively smaller third marginal tooth and its right mandible shows no trace of a second marginal tooth. The type species is this species. The type locality is São Paulo, Brazil; the description is based on material including complete colonies (major and minor soldiers with their nymphs, immature minor soldiers and workers, and numerous alates).
